items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: He wanted me to come out there and do it, you know

ctx.x: "La Danse" was the first of your own tunes that was recorded. Then "Deedle-ee Deedle-um". Did you ever record that yourself?

Yeah. I recorded that with Timmy Rogers. That was on RCA Victor and, of course, (Jon) Hendriks did it at the Newport Jazz Festival. Yeah, live. Yeah, Coleman Hawkins and Clark Terry, I forget who else was in the band behind it. But I couldn't make that job.
